text: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the Lord thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
explanation: Moses speaks this to an entire nation about to cross into unknown territory under new leadership. The command to not be afraid is not a denial of the danger — it is a redirection of attention to the companion. God going with you doesn't remove the risk; it changes the odds.
reflection: What 'Canaan' are you standing at the edge of, paralysed?
application: Take one step today that you've been postponing because you were waiting to feel ready.
memory: He goes with you. That changes the calculation.
prayer: Lord, I'm standing at an edge. Walk into it with me. Amen.
